conceptZh: 都：全部、通通；玩具戰士把一排彈珠都打光，每彈一下就落下一筆。
object: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield, and a swarm of bouncy colored rubber balls that ricochet around the frame
morph: every rubber ball that bounces off his shield drops one stroke of 都 into place, until all of them are used
creativeAngle: 玩具戰士想把所有的球都擋下來，卻只會亂揮泡棉劍；每顆球彈到盾牌或牆上，就落下一筆，所有球都用完字就完成了。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale powder-blue backdrop. Cast: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and a round shield, all bravado and very little skill, and a bag of bouncy rubber balls in red, yellow, green and blue that spill out and ricochet on their own. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 都, drawn in saturated crimson strokes, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the warrior stomps in, plants his shield, swings his foam sword in a big arc to show he will block everything, and trips over the open bag; five rubber balls pop out and bounce off the floor. The first narrated 都 lands as the red ball hits the shield with a bonk and drops one crimson stroke into the air. 1.5-3.5s: balls ricochet off the walls, the warrior's helmet and the underside of his shield, boing, boing, boing; he turns left, then right, then spins in a full circle swinging blindly, and each ricochet that connects drops one more stroke into place while the others bounce on. The second narrated 都 lands as the yellow ball clips his sword tip and drops the final stroke, completing 都. 3.5-5.0s: the warrior lifts his shield high and every remaining ball rolls into it and stops, all the colors nested like a bowl of candy; he stares at it in wide-eyed joy, and the shield sinks under the weight. As the word 都是 is spoken, the warrior points at each ball one after another, and all the balls give a small hop together, as if to say they are all his. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and readable for the last 3 seconds while the warrior, to one side, juggles two balls on his sword tip and does a small happy shield dance and the other balls bounce gently in place. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 都、都、都是 (ㄉㄡ、ㄉㄡ、ㄉㄡ ㄕˋ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized toys only, no real people.
